## Observation

On 2026-10-28 at 17:47:26 PDT (2026-10-29 00:47:26 UTC) the kernel OOM-killed the on-box `rebar-mcp` process (bug teenage-unquieted-ringworm). Docker restarted it in place (`restart=always`, same port). nginx answered `/mcp` with 502 from 00:47:27 to at least 00:47:53 UTC. The resets show the port accepted connections but nothing listened inside the container. The app answered again by 00:48:14. Claude Code 2.1.308 made its 5 reconnect attempts (1 s backoff doubling), the last at 00:47:43, then gave up. The session stayed disconnected until a manual `/mcp` reconnect.

## Root cause (measured; evidence in comments)

`mcp_server.main()` runs `run_startup_store_sweep()` (the idempotent ensure registry, `rebar._store.ensures.run_ensures`) synchronously BEFORE `build_server`/`run_mcp`, so nothing listens until the sweep ends. Since 3835269d792 (2026-10-28) the registry includes `snapshot-close-metadata`, which costs about 15-22 s even on a converged store. Measured:

- On the box, 2026-11-01 deploy: container start 08:57:12.54 UTC → uvicorn `Started server process` 08:57:36.93 (24.4 s). The startup handshake took 0.04 s.
- Locally, on an isolated copy of the tickets store: sweep 15.7-16.9 s, of which `snapshot-close-metadata` was 14.8-16.2 s; import, config and `build_server` together were under 1.7 s.
- On 2026-08-28 (dewy-rotatable-tarsier) start → uvicorn was 5.2-7.5 s.

Claude Code has no setting to raise its reconnect count (code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp, /env-vars; anthropics/claude-code#55228 closed not-planned, #101280 open). The fix therefore has to be server-side.

## Prior intent

`run_startup_store_sweep`'s docstring says the sweep "skips contention rather than delaying service". trivial-protected-barracuda rejected a warm standby and blue/green self-heal (memory doubling) and chose an in-place restart, so restart speed is the lever.

## Plan

1. `src/rebar/_mcp_health.py`: add `start_startup_store_sweep(gauge)`.
   - It resolves the tracker path synchronously, so a `RemovedInputError` from config still aborts startup, and the missing-store warning stays synchronous.
   - It then runs the ensure sweep on a background daemon thread. Before the thread starts, it takes `gauge.hold()` (the same hold the 1c51c9dcd06 drain counts) and releases it in a `finally`. `run_mcp`'s `wait_for_idle` and the SIGTERM drain therefore wait for the sweep, and the signer key copy outlives it.
   - The sweep body keeps the same call, `run_ensures(tracker, timeout=5, attempts=1)`, so lock semantics are unchanged. The existing exception handling moves into the thread unchanged: debug-log anything else, error-log a `RemovedInputError` that reaches the thread, since a thread cannot abort the process.
   - `run_startup_store_sweep()` keeps its synchronous behaviour and signature for its existing callers and tests, and shares the sweep body.
2. `src/rebar/mcp_server.py` `main()`: build the server first, then call `start_startup_store_sweep` with the server's wired gauge, then `run_mcp`.
3. `docs/migrations.md`: state that the MCP-boot sweep runs in the background after the server starts, is waited for at shutdown, and has unchanged lock behaviour.
4. Regression test `tests/unit/test_mcp_startup_sweep_background.py`.

Out of scope: changing the ensure units or their cost, nginx/compose/autodeploy, and the client.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] AC1: With `run_ensures` patched to block on an event, `mcp_server.main()` reaches `run_mcp` while the sweep is still blocked. Proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_mcp_startup_sweep_background.py`, which fails on the pre-fix ordering.
- [x] AC2: While the sweep is blocked, a server built by `build_server` with its health wiring answers an MCP `initialize` POST with 200 through its ASGI app. Same test file.
- [x] AC3: The sweep thread holds the server's in-flight gauge (value 1 while blocked, 0 after release), and `rebar._mcp_serving.wait_for_idle` does not return until the sweep finishes. Same test file.
- [x] AC4: The sweep thread calls `run_ensures` with `timeout=5, attempts=1` (lock semantics unchanged), and a `RemovedInputError` from tracker resolution still propagates synchronously from `start_startup_store_sweep`. Same test file; the existing `tests/unit/test_mcp_health_store_status.py` boot-sweep tests still pass.
- [x] AC5 [non-codebase]: On the first MCP autodeploy after merge, the box journal shows container start (`docker inspect` `State.StartedAt`) → uvicorn `Started server process` under 10 s.
      provenance: environment=AWS account 896586841071 us-east-1, instance i-00880b2c7f13527c5 (rebar-gerrit); principal=frontier profile operator via read-only `aws ssm send-command` (AWS-RunShellScript, docker inspect + journalctl -t rebar-mcp); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the measurement reads the production container's own start time and log, and no repository snapshot can replay that.
- [x] AC6: `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass.

## File impact

- `src/rebar/_mcp_health.py`: background sweep starter.
- `src/rebar/mcp_server.py`: `main()` ordering.
- `docs/migrations.md`: MCP-boot sweep timing.
- `tests/unit/test_mcp_startup_sweep_background.py`: regression test.
